name: Critical
label: Category
explanation_template: The {appliance} in your home is classified as Critical. It will NOT be affected during demand response events to protect food safety and essential services.

name: Schedulable
label: Category
explanation_template: Your {appliance} can be shifted to run during off-peak hours (23:00-06:00) to reduce your electricity cost. This does not affect its function, only its start time.

name: Curtailable
label: Category
explanation_template: During grid stress events, your {appliance} may be temporarily reduced. You are notified in advance and compensated with a bill credit of 3 BDT per curtailed kWh.
